name: AnimeGen I2V (open anime image-to-video model)
summary: Image-to-video model from AIdeaLab specialised in Japanese anime-style motion, character rendering and colour consistency. Fine-tune of Wan 2.2 I2V A14B, released with Diffusers inference and frame-interpolation examples. Useful for animating anime keyframes locally under a permissive license.

access.notes: Not gated. Needs the Wan 2.2 I2V A14B Diffusers VAE/pipeline (separate repo); RTX 4090-class GPU recommended.

procedure: Install torch, diffusers, transformers, accelerate, peft, safetensors, imageio-ffmpeg.
Load transformer and transformer_2 from aidealab/AnimeGen-I2V and the VAE from Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-Diffusers.
Run WanImageToVideoPipeline with an input image (example code on the model card, 480p or 720p, 16 fps).

verdict.why: Permissive Apache-2.0 with commercial use, not gated, real weights and working example code; niche anime focus and heavy GPU needs limit reach.
